title: harness: provider registry with capability negotiation
goal: Replace router.rs's six match arms with a data-driven provider registry: embedded JSON (id, wire family, base URL, key env, models with context/tools/vision/streaming and price ref) plus a user override file, alias resolution, and a generic OpenAI-compatible adapter so any provider is configuration. Refuse or degrade before dispatch when a model lacks a required capability. Wire gateway.rs and the binaries through the registry; keep the ledger and policy contracts unchanged.
